root.text: Yes, Detective? I have served Mr. Blackwood for 25 years. This is a tragic suicide.

choices.text: Tell me about Arthur's relationship with Victor Hayes.
Confront him about the glass vial found in the pantry.

james_alibi_tea.text: I was in the kitchen preparing Mr. Blackwood's evening chamomile tea between 9:30 PM and 10:30 PM. I never left the kitchen area.

james_tea_details.text: No, I brought it to his door, but the study was locked. I left it on the cart in the hallway, as he requested over the intercom.

james_about_victor.text: Mr. Hayes visited Mr. Blackwood regularly. However, their last business meeting ended in shouting. Arthur was furious about company accounts.

james_shouting_details.text: I couldn't hear clearly, but Mr. Blackwood threatened to involve the authorities. Victor Hayes looked pale when he departed.

james_pantry_confront.text: What?! A vial of potassium cyanide in my pantry? I swear on my life, I have never seen this! Someone must have planted it to frame me!

james_hallway_confront.text: Alright, yes! I walked down the study hallway at 10:00 PM to bring Arthur his tea. I lied because Detective Harris warned me that walking near the crime scene would make me the prime suspect. I didn't poison him!

root.text: Detective. Arthur's death is a shock to us all. Blackwood Industries has lost its visionary leader.

choices.text: What was your schedule last night?
Arthur was auditing company records. What did he find?
Confront him with the charred letter from the fireplace.

victor_alibi.text: I spent the entire night at my suburban residence in Elmwood, about an hour's drive from here. I was asleep by 9:30 PM.

victor_alibi_verification.text: I live alone, Detective. But my phone records and home automation logs will show no activity after 9:30 PM.

victor_audit.text: Our corporate finances are perfectly standard. We had some minor quarterly discrepancies, but nothing Arthur would raise concerns about.

victor_letter_confront.text: This... this is an outrageous fabrication! Arthur was prone to paranoia in his later years. This letter means nothing! You have no proof of any embezzlement.

victor_fraud_confront.text: You found the offshore transfers... Fine. Arthur found out. But that doesn't make me a killer. I visited him, yes, but he was alive when I left!

root.text: Detective, please make this quick. The police have already concluded it was suicide. I wish to grieve in peace.

choices.text: What can you tell me about Arthur's sleeping pills?
How was your relationship with Arthur recently?

eleanor_pills.text: Arthur took sleeping pills regularly. He was under immense stress and could barely sleep without them. I usually handed him the dose myself.

eleanor_relationship.text: We had a stable, mature marriage. Of course, we had our disagreements, but nothing out of the ordinary.

eleanor_divorce_confront.text: Alright, so I wanted a divorce, and he cut me out. But I was in my parlor reading. Ask Olivia if you don't believe me.

root.text: Hey. If you are here to ask me about the inheritance, save your breath. My dad was a control freak.

choices.text: What was your argument with Arthur yesterday about?
Where were you last night between 9 PM and 11 PM?

daniel_argument.text: He wanted me to join the firm and stop doing art auctions. I told him to stuff it. I don't care about his money anyway.

daniel_alibi.text: I was in the guest room listening to music. I didn't see anyone or hear anything because I had my headphones on.

daniel_debt_confront.text: Okay! I have gambling debts! The bookies are threatening to break my legs. I begged my dad for a loan, and he refused, saying a night in jail would teach me discipline. But I didn't kill him! If he's dead, I get my inheritance and pay the debts anyway, so why would I kill him early and risk jail?

root.text: Father never understood art. To him, everything was a balance sheet. What do you want, Detective?

choices.text: Did Arthur plan to change his will?

sophia_will.text: He threatened to write us all out. Especially Daniel. He wanted to leave it all to some corporate foundation. I told him he was being vindictive.

sophia_forgery_confront.text: Fine! I forged his signature on some certificates to cover studio rent. He didn't even care about those paintings. But murder? You're out of your mind.

root.text: Oh, Detective... I am so frightened. This house has secrets. I... I shouldn't speak.

choices.text: What did you see near the study last night?

olivia_sight.text: I saw someone in a dark trench coat slipping down the corridor toward the study around 10:00 PM. But it was too dark to see their face! I swear, I don't know who it was!

choices.text: Are you sure you couldn't identify them?

olivia_sight_hesitation.text: I... I can't say. I have a family to support, Detective. Please don't force me. They are powerful people.

olivia_witness_confront.text: It was Mr. Hayes! I recognized his walk and the silver cufflinks. After he left, he saw me in the pantry and told me if I told anyone, I would end up in a ditch. Please protect me, Detective!

choices.text: I will protect you. Thank you, Olivia.

root.text: Look, rookie. The study door was locked from the inside. There's a half-empty sleeping pill bottle, and a glass of wine. Arthur took his own life. Stop wasting taxpayers' money.

choices.text: What about the broken watch stopped at 9:17?
Why was there no suicide note?

harris_watch.text: He fell, the watch hit the desk, and broke. It matches the time his wife saw him enter the study. Simple physics.

harris_note.text: Not everyone leaves a note. Sometimes they are too depressed. Keep noseying around, and I'll have your private investigator license revoked.
